notablePrerequisites:
Captain of the Mists does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Humans.
description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least five 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Captain of the Mists triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Human Soldiers, adding {4}{U}.
Activate Captain of the Mists by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Humans as the combo begins, this combo nets infintie creature tokens, colored mana, and untap of permanents you control.
